Galician

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈkejʃo/ [ˈkej.ʃʊ]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ejʃo
  • Hyphenation: quei‧jo

Noun

[edit]

queijo m (plural queijos, reintegrationist norm)

  1. reintegrationist spelling of queixo (“cheese”)

References

[edit]
  • “queijo”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026

Old Galician-Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin cāseus (“cheese”). Cognate with Old Leonese keso and Old Spanish queso.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈkej.ʒo/

Noun

[edit]

queijo m (plural queijos)

  1. cheese
    • a. 1284, Alfonso X of Castile, Cantigas de Santa Maria, Códice de los músicos, cantiga 157 (facsimile):
      bon q̇ijo rezente
      good fresh cheese

Descendants

[edit]
  • Fala: queixhu, queixu (Valverdeñu)
  • Galician: queixo
  • Portuguese: queijo (see there for further descendants)

Portuguese

[edit]
Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
queijo
Wikipedia pt

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Galician-Portuguese queijo (“cheese”), from Latin cāseus (“cheese”), see there for more. Cognate with Galician queixo, Spanish queso, Italian cacio, Romanian caș and English cheese.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈke(j).ʒu/ [ˈke(ɪ̯).ʒu]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈke(j).ʒu/ [ˈke(ɪ̯).ʒu]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈke(j).ʒo/ [ˈke(ɪ̯).ʒo]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈkɐj.ʒu/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈkɐj.ʒu/
    • (Northern Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈkej.ʒu/
    • (Central Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈkej.ʒu/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈke.ʒu/

  • Audio (Portugal):(file)
  • Audio (Portugal):(file)
  • Rhymes: (Brazil) -ejʒu, -eʒu, (Portugal) -ɐjʒu
  • Hyphenation: quei‧jo

Noun

[edit]

queijo m (plural queijos)

  1. cheese (dairy product)
